question: Do current P3-03–07 semantics, load-bearing arguments and bounded implementations form a coherent restricted contract ready for Cycle III, and which optional recurrence would most improve the five author questions?
reliable_gain: Independent reconstruction of selected cross-task premises, source/evidence bindings and implementable predictions; exact readiness verdict and scope.
exploratory_gain: Challenge the cycle strongest unresolved operational links and propose a concrete recurrence with timing, acceptance target and cost, whether or not the minimum gate passes.
likely_failure: A valid local theorem is silently promoted across incompatible information, cost, source or feedback contracts; or apparent readiness obscures weak question-level insight and expensive ordinary comparisons.
first_informative_check: Construct a typed dependency map separating deterministic truth, logical source support, forecast estimates, checked counterfactual transport and acquired policy value; challenge the bridges and select only load-bearing checks.
criteria: Coherent restricted semantics, with explicit unsupported generalizations.
Checkable central arguments, independently reconstructed at the load-bearing bridge level.
Explicit logical uncertainty and counterfactual boundaries.
Nonvacuous positive or separating examples with strong ordinary comparisons.
Implementable predictions and bounded procedure/resource interfaces.
No unresolved errors in accepted downstream premises.
Cycle-level primary-question assessment and at least one concrete optional recurrence with a now/later recommendation.
concurrency_policy: Independent nonblind same-model reviewers; no parallel time added to principal research.
closure_policy: P3-B only. A technical PASS does not decide P3-N01 or start P3-08. Optional recurrence advice does not activate a new task.
